# OpenTimestamps example proofs

Copied byte-for-byte from the official opentimestamps-client repository,
https://github.com/opentimestamps/opentimestamps-client, commit
cd71c7609421bed2a07b9642a3c02a58c9fd2cdf:

- `*.ots`, `incomplete.txt`, `two-calendars.txt`, `hello-world.txt`: `examples/`
- `sha1-a-or-b.ots`: `examples/sha1/a-or-b.ots`
- `invalid/*.ots`: `examples/invalid/`

They are test data from that project, which is licensed under the GNU LGPL
v3 or later; see its LICENSE file.
